decisions.reason: Its continued standalone presentation over two years suggests performance at or above the firm's aspiration level, so a small incumbent would retain this close-to-core line.
Because it remained on the website in both years and fits the established facial-care range, management would likely judge it as meeting aspirations sufficiently to continue.
Its disappearance from the website by 2024 indicates results likely fell below aspiration, prompting the firm to reallocate scarce resources away from this product.
As a very recent launch in a growing market and close to the firm's existing capabilities, it would likely be kept for another period while performance is still uncertain.
